warnings: BOTH ENLARGEMENTS ARE TITLED แบบขยายราวบันได - the same title twice on one sheet at two scales (1:10 and 1:2). They are two views of the same balustrade, not two different railings, so they share this file; the ids are made distinct by scale per §0.3.

THE 1:2 PROFILE CARRIES DIMENSIONS DOWN TO 0.002 AND 0.003 m - two and three millimetres. At the reduction of this scan those figures sit right at the limit of what can be read reliably; they are recorded as printed with a flag rather than rounded or dropped. Anyone machining the baluster should work from the full-size sheet.
เซาะร่องลึก 5 มม. (a 5 mm groove) is the only unambiguous instruction on the 1:2 view and is recorded in full.
